token.description: HuggingFace [security token](https://huggingface.co/docs/hub/en/security-tokens) with read access to the model

include.description:
Filename patterns to include when filtering the repository's files @see [fnmatch](https://docs.python.org/3/library/fnmatch.html)
If None (default), all filenames match this filter, equivalent to ["*"]. Exclude is processed as a separate filter.

exclude.description:
Filename pattern to exclude when filtering the repository's files @see [fnmatch](https://docs.python.org/3/library/fnmatch.html)
If None (default), all filenames bypass this filter. Include is processed as a separate filter.

maxBatchSizeGb.description: Maximum batch size in GB. Files larger than this size will be placed into their own batch with size 1
